description: Nine source-linked exam briefs on anti-narcotics enforcement, consumer regulation, wetlands, a Bay of Bengal weather system, para sport, urban governance, BRICS parliamentary diplomacy, Kashi–Tamil cultural exchange and AI-enabled food innovation.

stories.title: NCB's Operation Trident targets a transnational narco-financial network
stories.summary: The Narcotics Control Bureau led coordinated searches at 38 locations across Assam, Mizoram and Manipur on 23 October; the Union Home Ministry disclosed the results on 25 October. The operation targeted both trafficking logistics and financial links, illustrating a shift from seizure-focused enforcement to network and asset disruption.
key_facts: Thirty-eight joint teams acted simultaneously at 38 identified locations in the three northeastern states.
The official release reported 18 arrests, about ₹100 crore in identified hawala transactions, 1,424 frozen bank accounts and ₹17.82 crore in attached property.
Investigators linked the network to routes connecting Myanmar, northeastern India, mainland India and Bangladesh.
The operation involved the NCB, state police and other central enforcement agencies.
stories.exam_link: Revise the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985; the NCB functions under the Union Ministry of Home Affairs, while police and public order are State List subjects.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Home Affairs, Operation Trident release — 25 October 2026

stories.title: CCPA penalises misleading walkie-talkie advertisements
stories.summary: The Central Consumer Protection Authority imposed a ₹1 lakh penalty on Hogar Technologies and Innovations LLP for product listings that did not clearly disclose operating frequencies, licensing requirements and regulatory approvals. The action forms part of a wider enforcement drive against misleading advertisements and non-compliant online sales of walkie-talkies.
key_facts: The CCPA said more than 16,970 non-compliant listings had been identified and notices issued to 13 e-commerce entities.
Final orders had been passed against 12 entities, with cumulative penalties of ₹58 lakh.
Advertisements must disclose operating frequency, licensing needs and other material regulatory information.
The CCPA exercises powers under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
stories.exam_link: Study the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, especially the CCPA's powers over misleading advertisements, unfair trade practices, product recall and penalties.
stories.source_title: Department of Consumer Affairs, CCPA walkie-talkie enforcement release — 25 October 2026

stories.title: India's Ramsar network reaches 103 wetlands
stories.summary: A PIB environment backgrounder reported that India had 103 Ramsar Sites covering more than 13.87 lakh hectares across 28 States and Union Territories as of October 2026. The network had grown from 26 sites in 2014, and Tamil Nadu had the largest state tally with 20 sites.
key_facts: India became a party to the Ramsar Convention on 1 February 1982.
The Convention on Wetlands was adopted at Ramsar, Iran, on 2 February 1971 and entered into force in 1975.
India ranked first in Asia and third globally by number of Ramsar Sites, according to the 25 October backgrounder.
The three Ramsar pillars are wise use of wetlands, designation and effective management of sites, and international cooperation.
stories.exam_link: Connect Ramsar designation with the Wetlands (Conservation and Management) Rules, 2017, and programmes such as NPCA, Amrit Dharohar, MISHTI and Mission Sahbhagita.
stories.source_title: PIB Backgrounder, Ramsar Sites in India — 25 October 2026

stories.title: Deep depression develops over the east-central Bay of Bengal
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department reported at 11:30 IST that a depression over the east-central and adjoining southeast Bay of Bengal had intensified into a deep depression. Its projected strengthening and landfall were forecasts, not completed events, and IMD issued an alert for Andhra Pradesh and adjoining south Odisha coasts.
key_facts: At 11:30 IST on 25 October, the system was centred near 15.1°N and 91.0°E, about 420 km north-northwest of Sri Vijaya Puram.
IMD forecast further intensification into a cyclonic storm on 26 October and a very severe cyclonic storm before the projected 28 October crossing.
The forecast crossing zone was the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam.
Fishermen were advised to avoid affected Bay of Bengal sectors, and squally conditions were also forecast off the north Tamil Nadu coast later in the period.
stories.exam_link: Revise tropical-cyclone formation over warm seas, IMD intensity categories, storm surge, and the role of IMD as a Regional Specialised Meteorological Centre for the North Indian Ocean.
stories.source_title: India Meteorological Department National Bulletin No. 5 — 25 October 2026, 11:30 IST

stories.title: India records 114 medals at the Asian Para Games 2026
stories.summary: India completed its best-ever Asian Para Games performance with a record 114 medals, according to a Prime Minister's Office release. The result is relevant to disability inclusion, sports governance and India's expanding para-sport ecosystem.
key_facts: The 114-medal haul was described by the government as India's highest total at an Asian Para Games.
The Asian Para Games are a multi-sport competition for athletes with disabilities and are distinct from the Asian Games.
Para-sport classification groups athletes according to how eligible impairments affect performance in a sport.
stories.exam_link: Review the roles of the Paralympic Committee of India, the Asian Paralympic Committee and the International Paralympic Committee, along with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
stories.source_title: Prime Minister's Office, India records 114 medals at Asian Para Games 2026 — 25 October 2026

stories.title: National Urban Conclave recommends stronger city institutions
stories.summary: The second National Urban Conclave concluded in Bhubaneswar after seven technical sessions. Its recommendations called for empowered urban local bodies, integrated spatial and infrastructure planning, stronger municipal finance, outcome-based service delivery and accountable, citizen-centred governance; these are recommendations, not enacted laws.
key_facts: The conclave was organised by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs with support from the Government of Odisha.
Sessions covered walkability, water and waste, affordable housing, integrated development and new models of urban service delivery.
A Used Water Marketplace under AMRUT 2.0 was launched to connect urban local bodies with potential users and investors in treated water.
A technical-cooperation memorandum between JICA and CPHEEO addressed circular use of treated wastewater.
stories.exam_link: Urban local bodies received constitutional status through the 74th Constitutional Amendment; review the Twelfth Schedule, municipal finance and metropolitan planning committees.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, National Urban Conclave 2026 concludes — 25 October 2026

stories.title: India prepares to host the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum
stories.summary: The Lok Sabha Secretariat announced that the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum would be inaugurated on 26 October in the Parliament House complex. Because the forum was scheduled for 26–27 October, the 25 October development was a preparatory announcement, not the forum's completion.
key_facts: The forum was scheduled in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan in New Delhi.
Its theme was 'Fostering Parliaments for People-Centric Development'.
Planned sessions were organised around resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability.
The programme included presiding officers and delegations from BRICS member and partner countries.
stories.exam_link: BRICS began as BRIC and added South Africa in 2010; distinguish intergovernmental summits from the parliamentary forum, which promotes dialogue among legislatures.
stories.source_title: Lok Sabha Secretariat, 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum to be inaugurated — 25 October 2026

stories.title: Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 dates and theme announced
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education announced that the fifth Kashi Tamil Sangamam would be held from 28 November to 12 December 2026. The programme is planned to connect Tamil Nadu and Kashi through cultural, academic and spiritual exchanges; as of 25 October, it remained an upcoming event.
key_facts: The theme is 'Thirukkural Payilvom – Thirukkural Abhyas Karen'.
Around 1,400 participants from Tamil Nadu were planned in seven groups of about 200 each.
The eight-day participant itinerary was to include Varanasi, Prayagraj and Ayodhya.
Registration was announced across seven categories, including students, teachers, agriculture and allied sectors, professionals, artisans, women and spiritual leaders.
stories.exam_link: Kashi Tamil Sangamam is associated with Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat; revise the Thirukkural, attributed to Thiruvalluvar, and the historical links between Tamil learning traditions and Kashi.
stories.source_title: Akashvani News, Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 schedule — 25 October 2026

stories.title: NIFTEM-K hosts AI and food-technology hackathon
stories.summary: The National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management, Kundli hosted 'Hack the Fork', described by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries as India's first AI × Food Tech hackathon. The 24-hour final brought selected teams together on 24–25 October to work on applications at the intersection of artificial intelligence, food systems and alternative proteins.
key_facts: The final was held at NIFTEM-K in Kundli, Haryana.
Twenty selected teams were invited to the 24-hour build.
Challenge tracks covered plant-based foods, fermentation and open food-system problems such as safety, nutrition, waste and supply chains.
NIFTEM-K is an institution under the Union Ministry of Food Processing Industries.
stories.exam_link: Link the event to food processing, value addition, alternative proteins, fermentation biotechnology and the use of AI for formulation, process control and food-supply chains.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Food Processing Industries, NIFTEM-K hosts Hack the Fork — 25 October 2026

mcqs.question: Which central body imposed the penalty over misleading walkie-talkie listings?
mcqs.explanation: The CCPA acted under the consumer-protection framework because material regulatory information was omitted from advertisements and listings.

mcqs.question: How many Ramsar Sites did India have according to the 25 October 2026 PIB backgrounder?
mcqs.explanation: The backgrounder reported 103 Ramsar Sites covering more than 13.87 lakh hectares.

mcqs.question: India became a party to the Ramsar Convention in which year?
mcqs.explanation: India became a contracting party on 1 February 1982.

mcqs.question: The deep depression reported by IMD on 25 October formed over which basin?
mcqs.explanation: IMD located the system over the east-central and adjoining southeast Bay of Bengal.

mcqs.question: Which statement best describes IMD's projected 28 October coastal crossing in the bulletin?
mcqs.explanation: The crossing between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam was a forecast, not an event already completed on 25 October.

mcqs.question: India's record medal total at the Asian Para Games 2026 was:
mcqs.explanation: The PMO release described 114 medals as India's best-ever Asian Para Games performance.

mcqs.question: Which constitutional amendment gave constitutional status to urban local bodies?
mcqs.explanation: The 74th Constitutional Amendment created the constitutional framework for municipalities and the Twelfth Schedule.

mcqs.question: The Used Water Marketplace launched at the National Urban Conclave is associated with which mission?
mcqs.explanation: The conclave release identified it as a platform under AMRUT 2.0 for transactions involving treated used water.

mcqs.question: Where was the National Urban Conclave 2026 concluded?
mcqs.explanation: The second National Urban Conclave concluded in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.

mcqs.question: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum was scheduled to meet in which venue?
mcqs.explanation: The Lok Sabha Secretariat announced the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan as the venue.

mcqs.question: Which of the following was not one of the four planned BRICS Parliamentary Forum session pillars?
mcqs.explanation: The four pillars were resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability.

mcqs.question: What is the announced theme of Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0?
mcqs.explanation: The Ministry of Education announced the bilingual Thirukkural-focused theme.

mcqs.question: Kashi Tamil Sangamam 5.0 was announced for which dates?
mcqs.explanation: The fifth edition was scheduled from 28 November through 12 December 2026.
